key_message: All 10 escape attempts blocked this run (IDN/punycode encoding, awmg-mcpg endpoint enumeration, HTTP/0.9 legacy smuggling, WebSocket-Upgrade-in-CONNECT, vertical-tab whitespace in CONNECT authority, internal sidecar direct-HTTPS probing, duplicate Host headers, CONNECT+pipelined-request smuggling, read-only nsswitch/hosts tamper attempt, unix socket enumeration).
